title: Enabling Proactive Spoken Turns via a Generalized Style-Aware Full-Duplex Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.28630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compared with half-duplex dialogue systems where the system waits for user turn completion before it responds, natural full-duplex dialogue systems require agents to act proactively in real time, including timely interruptions and backchannels. This creates a key challenge: improving turn timing without sacrificing response quality. To address limitations in realistic proactive turn-taking, we build a generalized style-aware full-duplex framework with three key components. Firstly, we propose LPS-TC, a Lightweight Proactive Speech Turn Controller for plug-and-play integration. It features a fine-grained action space covering both reactive and proactive turn behaviors, enabling half-duplex models with full-duplex capabilities and enhancing existing full-duplex models with superior timing control. Secondly, we construct WildTurn, a large-scale, real-world English dataset containing approximately 2,981 hours of filtered multi-turn stereo

translated_title: 通过广义风格感知全双工框架实现主动语音轮次
translated_abstract: 与半双工对话系统（系统需等待用户轮次完成后才响应）相比，自然的全双工对话系统要求智能体能够实时主动行动，包括及时打断和反馈信号。这带来了一个关键挑战：在不牺牲响应质量的前提下改进轮次时机。为解决现实中主动轮次转换的局限性，我们构建了一个广义的风格感知全双工框架，包含三个关键组件。首先，我们提出LPS-TC——一个轻量级主动语音轮次控制器，支持即插即用集成。它具有覆盖反应式和主动式轮次行为的细粒度动作空间，使半双工模型具备全双工能力，并以卓越的时机控制增强现有全双工模型。其次，我们构建了WildTurn——一个大规模真实场景英语数据集，包含约2,981小时的经过筛选的多轮双声道（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个广义风格感知全双工框架，通过即插即用的轻量级主动语音轮次控制器LPS-TC和大规模真实英语数据集WildTurn，在不牺牲响应质量的前提下显著提升全双工对话系统的主动轮次时机控制能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generalized style-aware full-duplex framework, featuring a plug-and-play lightweight proactive speech turn controller (LPS-TC) and a large-scale real-world English dataset (WildTurn), which improves proactive turn-taking timing without sacrificing response quality.
